body: {"better": "A", "reason": "Card B uses imperative నడవండి (you walk) which is commanding and slightly stiff for a daughter speaking to her mother; Card A uses natural inclusive వెళ్దాం/వెళ్ళవచ్చు (let's go/one can go) which is warmer. Card A also gives the concrete reason 'పార్కులో కాసేపు హాయిగా ఉండొచ్చు' (can relax in the park) which is more inviting than B's vaguer 'ప్రశాంతంగా కూర్చోవచ
